release_notes: Reconciliation is now a Control Room with a decision banner, operational KPI cards, and a focused Action Queue.
Tracking-only shipment IDs, parser warnings, and courier review actions now persist review state and refresh only affected surfaces.
Output & Export now includes Line-Based AWB Pack plus a lighter Report / Batch History panel that stays collapsed until needed.
Operation Narrative now explains Batch Input, AWB Reconciliation, Allocation Status, Attention Needed, Recommended Next Action, and Output Location in operator language.
